🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals—Energy, Utilities, Consumer Staples and Real Estate showing 1W strength while Technology, Financials and Healthcare lag; leadership narrowly concentrated in Technology top performers (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 tech in Top 5), so style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +8.89% | 1M: -1.37%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +7.99% | 1M: -6.13%) RECOVERY, XOM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: -9.80%) RECOVERY. Consumer Staples strong: CVS (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +20.67%) ABOVE TREND, MDLZ (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +5.70%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate showing upside: VTR (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +7.73%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication lagging: CMCSA (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -34.57% | 1M: -28.19%) BELOW TREND. Materials weak: FCX (1W: -19.09% | 1M: +4.40%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary mixed/soft: HD (1W: -4.92% | 1M: -0.21%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -3.80% | 1M: +4.93%) CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +45.17% | 1M: +130.03%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +22.77%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +44.42%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.09% | 1M: +71.96%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +20.67%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SHOP (1W: -8.11% | 1M: +8.49%) CORRECTION, LMT (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -14.83%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -9.28% | 1M: -2.87%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -9.60% | 1M: +0.31%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Communication and Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +45.17% | 1M: +130.03%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +22.77%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +44.42%) ABOVE TREND — Major divergence present: multiple megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, JPM) show 1W weakness vs 1M strength, so treat momentum as tactical until confirmed.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but internally bifurcated: NVDA (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +26.69%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +27.95%) ABOVE TREND, while AAPL (1W: -1.10% | 1M: +9.54%) CORRECTION and MSFT (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +18.25%) CORRECTION show short-term exhaustion; sector 1W: -0.13% vs 1M: +20.61% — watch for consolidation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed leadership in payments vs banks: V (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.95% | 1M: +6.50%) ABOVE TREND, while JPM (1W: -1.20% | 1M: +9.54%) CORRECTION; sector 1W: -0.79% | 1M: +9.67% — selective exposure to card/processor strength favored.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Soft overall: UNH (1W: +4.87% | 1M: +41.62%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.55% | 1M: -6.24%) RECOVERY, but LLY (1W: -7.63% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -1.85% | 1M: -0.29% and headline risk is elevated.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to recent 1W leaders in semiconductors and payments (INTC, QCOM, V) while reducing exposure to names showing short-term exhaustion (AAPL, MSFT, NOW, ORCL); style mixed — momentum in a narrow tech cohort but broader market lacks breadth, so monitor confirmation before adding to core positions.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +45.17% | 1M: +130.03%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through; QCOM (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +22.77%) ABOVE TREND — news-confirmed; UNH (1W: +4.87% | 1M: +41.62%) ABOVE TREND — earnings momentum. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -34.57% | 1M: -28.19%) BELOW TREND — downside continuation risk; NOW (1W: -13.76% | 1M: -15.32%) BELOW TREND; LLY (1W: -7.63% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -3.46%) — tactical strength, watch follow-through; Consumer Staples (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +2.54%) — defensive bid. BEARISH: Communication (1W: -4.50% | 1M: -3.95%) and Materials (1W: -3.13% | 1M: +5.05%) — high dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch INTC weekly breakout/failure relative to this week’s high for confirmation of the rally; NVDA needs to hold recent weekly support to keep ABOVE TREND momentum; V must sustain above this week’s surge to signal broad financials follow-through.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
QCOM (+60): Surprise AI chip report — QCOM (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +22.77%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. V (+60): EPS beat and buyback — V (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND — confirming. MSFT (+60): Strong AI revenue commentary — MSFT (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +18.25%) CORRECTION — news bullish but 1W price shows short-term distribution.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (-45): Canada generic weight-loss note — LLY (1W: -7.63% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. META (-50): Higher AI spend outlook — META (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +24.75%) CORRECTION — negative headlines but 1M strength; watch for follow-through. XOM (-45): Lawsuit/ESG headline — XOM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: -9.80%) RECOVERY — bearish headlines but short-term price is recovering, divergence to monitor.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC (1W: +45.17% | 1M: +130.03%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +22.77%) ABOVE TREND and V (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Major divergence across megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, JPM showing 1W weakness vs 1M strength) and narrow tech leadership warrant monitoring for confirmation before broadening exposure.
